retrievalProfile.description: A soft-focus portrait of a woman in a grey turtleneck against a twilight window, featuring elegant copper-toned script typography.
triggerTerms: soft focus portrait with window bokeh
excludeWhen: modern minimalist sans-serif typography is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, medium-shot portrait of a woman with short, voluminous curly hair wearing a grey wool turtleneck. The background consists of a white-framed window looking out onto a soft-focus dusk landscape with warm bokeh lights. The overall mood is intimate, calm, and sophisticated, utilizing a muted color palette with a single metallic typographic accent.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered against a grid-like window frame
Soft, diffused lighting on the face contrasting with the cool blue of the dusk background
Warm copper-toned typography layered over the neutral grey of the sweater
Textured knitwear providing tactile contrast to the smooth skin and blurred background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered, medium close-up, occupying the central vertical third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and eyes serve as the primary focal point, anchored by the high collar of the turtleneck.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the subject's face down to the large script name, then to the smaller subtitle below it.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper quadrants of the window frame provide breathing room around the subject's head.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm skin tones and white window frames
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with mid-range values; the metallic text provides the highest chroma.

letterConstructionRules: High contrast between thick and thin strokes
Long, sweeping swashes on capital letters
Connected lowercase letters with fluid transitions
Slightly irregular, hand-drawn feel to the terminals
characterSpecificRedesigns: Exaggerated descenders and ascenders that overlap the subject's torso
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Large metallic script paired with a smaller, lighter white script for hierarchical contrast.
graphicDevices: Soft bokeh light circles in the background

preserve: Metallic copper color for main text

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the elegant, high-contrast 90s calligraphic look
Provides the necessary swashes and formal elegance

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus portrait of a woman with short curly hair wearing a grey heathered turtleneck sweater, positioned in front of a white-paned window at dusk with warm bokeh lights visible through the glass.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, elegant copper-toned script name across the lower chest area, followed by a smaller white script title aligned to the right underneath.

verificationChecks: Text is legible against the grey sweater
Lighting on the face is soft and flattering
Window panes are visible but blurred

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artist
postGenerationChecks: Does the image evoke a 1990s adult contemporary aesthetic?
Is the copper text clearly the primary graphic element?
Is the background blur natural and consistent with a wide aperture?
Does the subject's pose feel relaxed and intimate?
recipe.reuseFormula: Soft-lit portrait + grey knitwear + twilight window + copper script = 90s Sophistication
